McGraw Hill

Matching literacy mechanics to learning goals.

Early mini-game concepts for McGraw Hill explore how literacy activities can change across kindergarten through third grade.

ProjectMcGraw Hill
Contribution / source recordProject-specific role and delivery scope to confirm.

Design approach

  • A grade-level matrix connects matching, spelling, sequencing and sentence-building to different learning tasks.
  • Sequencing wireframes turn before/during/after relationships into direct manipulation activities.
  • Concept exploration considers both task structure and the visual resources needed to support it.

Why this work matters

The strongest angle is the design judgment involved in choosing an interaction for a learning objective, rather than treating games as interchangeable formats.
